Take your event to the next level with our Game Customization add-on.

For an additional fee, we can personalize select games with custom vinyl decals — perfect for showcasing your monogram, logo, hashtag, or special message .

Whether you're planning a wedding, corporate event, or milestone celebration, this is a fun and stylish way to make your rentals truly one-of-a-kind.
